source.published_article: Leirs et al. 2023 Scientific Data doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02700-3

published_schedule.original_previous_proxy: 182 calendar-months with exactly 3 consecutive MN capture-bearing dates

correction.prior_result: 135 of 140 missing codes only observed outside exact within-calendar-month 3-MN-capture-day proxy
correction.updated_decision: The previous 135/140 proxy count is valid only as a conservative MN-capture-day screen, not proof of author occasion exclusion. Actual author retained 363 primary sessions yield 119/140 with no same-day capture and 21/140 with at least one same-day capture.

decision.biological_interpretation: Unresolved published animal identities and occasion filtering remain upstream of any external-space use or abundance inference. Original Mastomys data cannot be claimed to replicate mammal spatial ecology yet.
decision.next_action: Effect-blind cross-tab of 21 residual missing MN source TOE codes by valid station, species NA matrix overlap, flag, 2-night support and published RMarkdown manual date deletions; if IDs remain irreconcilable obtain author clarification. Never invent split TOE IDs.
